errors.text: The hypothesis predicts a single-phase or BCC-dominant product, whereas the target product is FCC-dominant: approximately 83% FCC and 17% BCC.
The statement that VEC must remain above a critical threshold for BCC stability reverses the usual VEC trend in HEAs, where higher VEC generally favors FCC and lower VEC favors BCC.
The proposed low-load hardness test alone cannot isolate grain-boundary strengthening from precipitation hardening without phase-matched or grain-size-matched controls.
